## Key Features
- SW Roofing offers roof replacement, shingle installation, hail damage roof replacement, siding, eavestrough installation, and soffit & fascia services and GoNano shingle treatment across Saskatoon and Calgary.
- Most roofing projects completed in just 1 day by in-house, directly employed crews — SW Roofing never subcontracts, so homeowners always know who is on their roof.
- Industry-leading 10-year workmanship warranty on all roofing, siding, and eavestrough installations, plus IKO's Limited Lifetime Warranty on asphalt shingles.
- Free estimates and inspections provided within 24 hours of contact, with transparent, upfront pricing and no hidden fees — you pay exactly what you're quoted.
- HAAG-certified hail damage inspections with full insurance support, offering homeowners expert guidance from assessment through to completed replacement.
- Installs 5" seamless aluminum and steel eavestroughs engineered for 30% better water flow, fewer clogs, and a clean, leak-resistant finish.
- Premium shingle options from IKO, Malarkey, Euro Shield, and Decra — offering lifetime warranties, superior weather protection, and modern curb appeal.
- Siding installations include Hardie Board and vinyl options in a range of styles and colors, with exterior insulation available for added energy savings.
- Soffit and fascia installations improve attic ventilation, prevent attic rain and shingle curling, and enhance overall home curb appeal.
- Trusted by 5,000+ homeowners across Saskatoon, Calgary, and surrounding areas, with 15+ years of experience, 50+ team members, and 1M+ shingles laid.
